text:
You just met him,
so there's no need
to visit again.
Mr. Stripes' house
is over there, but...
He's always slacking off
and taking a nap
somewhere!
Is that so?
Hehe. Is that so?
That's why
Marurur has to
look after him...
He certainly did
seem rather
unmotivated.
I see...
He certainly may
have seemed rather
unmotivated.
Before I left,
I asked him
to wait for us, but...
Ooh, I'm worried...
Huh? It looks like
the path continues
further in...
Hey, Marurur.
What's
beyond here?
Marurur,
what's
beyond here?
Huh? Oh, um...
Well, you see...
Ooh...
?
Well, never mind.
We'll find out
if we go and look.
Well, anyway,
we won't know
until we go and look.
...
Falzen...
Why are you
blocking the path?
BECAUSE IT IS
DANGEROUS BEYOND HERE.
Huh?
The area around the ruins
ahead has become
a gathering place for ghosts.
Ghosts?
The ghosts of those
who died in the last war.
!
Those ruins were
the administration facility
when this island was a testing ground.
Naturally, they were
the scene of
the fiercest fighting.
THEY HATE ALL LIVING THINGS.
THEY WILL NOT LISTEN
EVEN TO US...
EVEN WE GUARDIANS
MUST NOT APPROACH
WITHOUT PERMISSION...
I see...
I see...
NOW THAT YOU UNDERSTAND,
GO
ELSEWHERE...
That would be wise.
Yes, I will.
Then I will.
...Sorry, but everything
beyond here
is off-limits.
